name: Scheduler Endpoint
helpText: This time-event endpoint represents the cron schedule driving a Scheduled/FTP/SFTP/Local File Consumer, rather than an external system.
allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

componentName.helpText: Text displayed for the endpoint, such as a host, database name or filename. The owning flow element normally supplies it through endpointTextKey.
